input_options.title: Input options
input_options.description: Define mandatory inputs for the pipeline

design_file.description: A CSV file with the paths to the federated results to aggregate
design_file.help_text: The CSV file should contain a header, with the parameter names. Each column corresponds to one parameter and each row corresponds to one federated analysis. In each field, could be more than one filepath, separated by `;` semi-colon. Missing fields are denoted by `MISSING_FILE`.

federated_aggregation_options.title: Federated aggregation options
federated_aggregation_options.description: Control which aggregation phase to run and how to combine site parameters

phase.help_text: `consensus` (Phase 1): tally each site's selected features and broadcast the consensus feature set. `aggregate` (Phase 2): combine the site coefficient vectors and forests into the federated model.

aggregation.description: Rule for combining site coefficient vectors (Phase 2)
aggregation.help_text: `fedavg` averages coefficients weighted by each site's number of subjects; `median` and `mean` are unweighted.

min_sites.description: Consensus threshold: keep a feature selected by at least this many sites (Phase 1)
min_sites.help_text: Leave unset to use a simple majority (number of sites / 2 + 1).
